enchantments.tooltip: Armor Bonus +4: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +4 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Natural Armor +4: Passive: +4 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
Boon of Undeath: Undead take solace in the hate of others. Every time a character wearing a Boon of Undeath item is struck in combat, an Inflict Light Wounds spell will be cast on the character.
Void Lore V: Passive: Your Negative Energy and Poison spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Lightning Lore V: Passive: Your Electricity spells gain a 15% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Light Resistance +20: Passive: +20 Enhancement bonus to your Light Resistance.

Upgradeable Item (Black Abbot): This item could be upgraded if you found a Seal of the Black Abbot to combine it with. Bring this item to the Fountain of Necrotic Might outside the Black Mausoleum and combine it with a Seal of the Black Abbot to upgrade the item to a more powerful form.

Lesser Arcane Augmentation IX: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by one.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
